rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using name and zip, identified the correct pending order (#W5270061), and selected valid variants for the requested item changes. However, it performed order-changing writes without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit user confirmation, violating policy. Specifically, it modified the backpack and desk lamp and charged an additional amount to the gift card without prior confirmation. It then attempted to change the shipping address without explicit confirmation and received a tool error; afterward, it asserted that no further changes (including address and payment) were possible, which was not clearly supported by tools and conflicted with the fact that the order already showed a gift card payment. The agent also failed to note that the order had already been paid with a gift card when the user asked to pay by gift card. Due to missing required confirmations and misleading final information, the conversation fails the pass criteria.
